notes.title: One Week Until Release!
notes.notes:
[b]There's only a week left before HACK_IT releases on Steam, so here's an update on some new gameplay elements that you might find interesting![/b]

I polished the CMD as the story progresses, it will also be included in some bonus missions on the bonus level selection screen. 
[img]http://i.imgur.com/insGYhL.png[/img]

This was quite hard to get polished off, but I'm happy to announce It's working and functioning great, there's something pleasing about it, maybe I'm just a nerd? 

Pin-Code Hacking
One of the elements I started work on a few weeks ago was the idea of hacking into a online banking account using a pin-code, I think It's cool!
[img]http://i.imgur.com/OLHNsvp.png[/img]

I'm very happy with the wishlists and official group member stats, I expect these to increase as the days pass and the game starts hitting the front page on the upcoming section, and post-release.

-$5 on Steam
-Single-player Experience 
-Bonus Hacking Missions 
-Steam Achievements 
-Steam Trading Cards

Feel free to join the official group and add the game to your wishlist if you haven't already!

Official Group: http://steamcommunity.com/games/444350/
Frequently Asked Questions: http://steamcommunity.com/app/444350/discussions/0/365163686083521190/
